documents.title: Framework agreement
documents.text:
Framework agreement: Castellan Healthcare (fictional, authored test material).
Castellan Healthcare had annual service charges of SEK 20.4m in FY2024 (reported basis). For Castellan Healthcare, payment terms with effect from 1 Jul 2025 was 35 days. Delay penalty cap at Castellan Healthcare stood at 12.2% in FY2025. Castellan Healthcare had incident response time of 8 hours in FY2025 (reported basis).

documents.title: Change order
documents.text:
Change order: Castellan Healthcare (fictional, authored test material).
Castellan Healthcare had annual service charges of roughly SEK 20m in FY2024 (reported basis). For Castellan Healthcare, payment terms with effect from 1 Jan 2025 was 46 days. Total contract value at Castellan Healthcare stood at SEK 23.3m in FY2025 (reported basis). Volume rebate of Castellan Healthcare in FY2025: to be confirmed; not included in this document.

documents.title: Procurement evaluation note
documents.text:
Procurement evaluation note: Castellan Healthcare (fictional, authored test material).
Castellan Healthcare had delay penalty cap of 16.5% in FY2025. For Castellan Healthcare, incident response time in FY2025 was 7 hours (pro forma (including the planned acquisition) basis). Total contract value at Castellan Healthcare stood at SEK 18m (reported basis). Castellan Healthcare had volume rebate of 2.2% in FY2025.
